# Vendored browser runtime

- Egret Engine community rebuild, branch main, pinned commit [db9772ee104e77b5c34e4c59bbc6f7dde7e90419](https://github.com/cnedwin/Egret_rebuild/tree/db9772ee104e77b5c34e4c59bbc6f7dde7e90419).
- The contracts, runtime and engine packages were built from that Git checkout (tree 8ed766202af5edd8648a38e3e12f291307792121).
- Built with Node.js 26.7.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2 using upstream `node tools/build.mjs`.
- robust-predicates 3.0.3 is the engine dependency. The original license is retained next to the package.
